what: 1. Planned parser only recognizes repo-relative script prefixes, but real /design command blocks commonly invoke scripts through quoted ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/... paths
scenario_or_breakage: The Step 2b and Step 5c validators would silently drop the dominant in-repo invocation style, so unknown flags on plan-block-write.sh, design-driver.sh, or other plugin scripts would not be checked
suggested_fix: Normalize command tokens before filtering: strip simple quotes, map ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/, $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/, and absolute repo-root prefixes to repo-relative paths, then add parser fixtures using existing SKILL.md command shapes

what: 2. NEW/UPDATED allow-list syntax is planned as ### NEW/UPDATED headings, but /design's plan contract does not require that format and the current plan style uses Files to create/update bullets
scenario_or_breakage: New scripts or newly added flags documented in normal /design plans will not be allow-listed, causing false missing-script or unknown-flag failures during Step 2b/5c
suggested_fix: Align the parser with the actual plan format or update SKILL.md to require a canonical machine-readable Files-to-create/update syntax; cover both NEW file and UPDATED Adds flag examples in fixtures

what: 3. Unknown-flag handling is internally contradictory: Tier 2 says a flag absent from help is DEFECT, while the edge case says emit SKIPPED_FLAG_CHECK reason=flag-not-in-help
scenario_or_breakage: The acceptance case for --context-files can be downgraded to a skip instead of blocking, recreating the exact failure mode this validator is meant to prevent
suggested_fix: Keep absent flags as DEFECT kind=unknown-flag when help output is usable; reserve SKIPPED_FLAG_CHECK only for unavailable or empty help, or add an explicit documented per-script exception mechanism with tests

what: 4. The wrapper contract does not define how ACTION=VALIDATE_PLAN_COMMANDS selects plan.txt versus composed-plan.md
scenario_or_breakage: Step 5c may re-validate the stale Step 2b plan.txt instead of the composed plan that will be written to GitHub, or implementations may invent incompatible ad hoc source selection
suggested_fix: Add an explicit validate-plan.sh CLI such as --plan-file FILE, pass it from both Step 2b and Step 5c through ACTION ARGS, and document/test the driver dispatch for both source files
